prompt: Green trades lunch for a dinosaur book
title: Dinosaur Book Trade
irony: Green trades his lunch to feed his head with dinosaur facts, then his hungry tummy roars louder than any dinosaur until sharing lunch back fills everyone.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Green hugs his lunchbox outside Gold's Diner while Black waves a big dinosaur book.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green names dinosaurs at a booth, corrects Red with Actually, and eyes Black's book.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Black offers the dinosaur book for Green's lunch, and Green's tummy rumbles loudly.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The kids chant around the table as Green slides his lunchbox toward Black.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Green reads fast with no bites and calls his sandwich a fossil, tummy growling.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Green's tummy roars like a T. rex and the whole diner laughs with him.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The kids chant around the table while Green holds the book and rubs his tummy.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Gold watches Green and remembers quietly paying for Silver's soup on rainy days.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Gold splits a warm diner lunch to share and asks Green to read one page aloud.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Gold turns the chant to sharing lunch while Green reads dinosaur names aloud.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Outside the Diner Green shares his sandwich and reads the dinosaur book with friends.
